newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zaire news conference set for 1430 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Zaire news conference set for 1430 GMT.

text.p: A news conference to announce the outcome of a military meeting on aid for Zaire's refugee crisis was set for 3.30 p.m. (1430 GMT), a Canadian military spokesman said on Friday.

Military officials from 29 countries and representatives of eight international organisations were meeting to discuss options for a military intervention to help the estimated 1.2 million refugees displaced by the conflict in eastern Zaire.
"We are aiming for a news conference at 3.30," the Canadian spokesman said. It was not clear whether the meeting would have completed its business by then.

Foreign minister Lloyd Axworthy of Canada, which is coordinating the multinational mission, had said on Thursday that the meeting would not make any decision but would evaluate available information and set out a number of options.
Countries represented at the meeting included major prospective participants the United States, France, Spain and Britain. There were no delegations from Rwanda or Zaire present.
